selected_design: append-only evidence ledger plus deterministic mutually-exclusive assessment projection
required_assertions: Every assessment revision has exactly one registered mutually exclusive state; only F9_CONFIRMED_SYNTHETIC maps to true, only MATURE_NO_F9_SYNTHETIC maps to false, and every other state maps to null.

A positive requires a relevant decision-maker or authorized representative, a current CRE requirement or credible future CRE requirement, a scheduled conversation with an identified senior commercial realtor, independently adjudicable evidence, PASS adjudication, an in-window booking confirmation, and canonical deduplication.

A mature negative requires the complete registered window plus grace to have elapsed, an eligible source_complete=true watermark through the window end, explicit negative adjudication, no qualifying booking, and no censoring, conflict, duplicate ambiguity, or competing event; absence alone is never negative.
IMMATURE_UNKNOWN, CENSORED_UNKNOWN, COMPETING_EVENT_UNKNOWN, CONFLICTED_UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN are never counted as negative or positive.

Censoring is loss of observation; a competing event is a separately typed observed opportunity-ending event. They have distinct cause, time, evidence, and adjudication lineage and neither proves a negative.
Every synthetic stopping-event evidence digest deterministically binds its outcome unit, registered assertion type, registered cause, occurrence clock, and fixture evidence kind.

The synthetic F9 window uses an explicit closed interval [starts_at, ends_at]; start/end minus one second, equality, and plus one second are independently tested. The fixture horizon is not an authorized real policy.

The primary route-day ITT window binds the representative-route-day assignment/start anchor and includes ABSTAIN and nonadherent route-days. A field-event-anchored window is explicitly secondary/observational and cannot replace the ITT outcome.

Policy registration, Stage-1 issuance, assignment/anchor, window start/end, evidence occurrence, recording, ingestion, validation, availability, observation watermark, adjudication, assessment, correction assertion, and correction availability clocks remain distinct and correctly ordered.
An assessment uses only assertions and corrections available at or before its as-of cutoff. Late evidence may append a successor assessment but cannot rewrite the prior as-of record.

Corrections form one acyclic, gapless, single-parent, single-head revision chain with predecessor ID/hash, transition reason, later availability, invariant outcome-unit/Stage-1/policy bindings, and immutable prior bytes.

The booking-episode key is invariant to candidate, route-day, representative, and channel presentation; current-head deduplication is computed from active assertions at one common registered route-day as-of cutoff. Exactly one canonical episode may count, retracted/future assertions cannot reserve it, and unresolved cross-unit collisions remain conflicted/null.

Stage-3 assertions, corrections, assessments, dedupe, and route-day aggregation cannot alter the bound Stage-1 source, candidate, decision, selected locations/order, policy, route result, route manifest, or field-event bytes.

Cancellation and no-show are not inferred or represented by this synthetic contract: attendance remains UNKNOWN, and any future cancellation/no-show treatment requires an authorized downstream policy plus append-only adjudicable evidence; only a correction to the booking fact may alter the F9 booking assessment.
Attendance, mandate, transaction, commission, referral, repeat value, predictive validity, incremental lift, and net commercial value remain unknown and cannot be inferred from a booking.

The canonical route-day with three confirmed positives and any still-open units reports confirmed_f9_lower_bound=3, final_f9_count=null, and IMMATURE_PARTIAL; final_f9_count is emitted only when the full route-day outcome set is mature under the registered policy.

The independent evaluator first validates and binds the strict input ledger to the frozen canonical ledger and scenario matrix, then reconstructs assessments, correction lineage, active-as-of dedupe groups, label vector, route-day aggregate, Stage-1 digest, and replay receipt without importing or trusting the outcome builder.
projection_precedence: invalid or missing unit, policy, or Stage-1 binding -> UNKNOWN
material conflict, unresolved cross-unit dedupe collision, or exact-time F9/stopping-event tie -> CONFLICTED_UNKNOWN
fully adjudicated canonical F9 in the registered window and before any stopping event -> F9_CONFIRMED_SYNTHETIC
censoring is the first stopping event -> CENSORED_UNKNOWN
a registered competing event is the first stopping event -> COMPETING_EVENT_UNKNOWN
assessment, watermark, or grace has not completed the window -> IMMATURE_UNKNOWN
complete window/watermark/grace with explicit negative adjudication and no qualifying event -> MATURE_NO_F9_SYNTHETIC
bounded_properties: the exact-ten canonical route-day has ten outcome units, twenty append-only assessment revisions, and one common current-head as-of cutoff
twenty seeded unit/assertion permutations and exact duplicate assertion presentation multiplicities one through three are byte-canonical
all seven registered assessment states, derived labels, and ascertainment states are present and checked

the positive predicate is independently checked for allowed actor/requirement/appointment/adjudication values, identified realtor, evidence digest, event/availability/as-of order, registered window, and canonical deduplication
closed-interval start/end minus one second, equality, and plus one second are directly checked for the F9 booking clock
same-time F9 and stopping event remains conflicted rather than ordering by ID or ingestion order
every assessment binds the cross-unit active booking-group projection at its cutoff through dedupe_snapshot_sha256
the canonical correction has an immutable target digest and a three-revision single-parent assessment chain that preserves prior bytes and Stage 1
future-unavailable and retracted assertions cannot reserve a dedupe key; the registered cross-unit booking collision preserves one canonical count at the common as-of
route-day aggregates distinguish confirmed lower bound from final mature count
ISSUE-adherent, ISSUE-nonadherent, and ABSTAIN_NO_VALID_TEN assignments all remain in the route-day ITT inclusion registry without inventing outcome counts

strict input/output schemas and fail-closed parsing reject unsupported assertion types, extra fields, floats, naive/noncanonical clocks, unit mismatches, missing fields, invalid correction targets, unregistered stoppers, and unsupported versions
diagnostic_precedence: correction lineage, as-of leakage, and clock order
state/label, F9 conjunct, window, maturity, and route-day aggregation semantics
replay_receipt_must_bind: frozen source, candidate, decision, route, and field-event hashes
strict input-ledger schema hash and frozen input-ledger hash
sorted assertion, correction, assessment, and booking-episode digests
candidate label vector and route-day aggregate digest
state/count summary and explicit proof ceiling
pass_rule: All required assertions and bounded properties pass; all 36 registered mutations return their exact diagnostic, including dedicated rehashed input, label, dedupe, lineage, evidence-digest, and receipt classes after the relevant attacker-controlled digests are recomputed; canonical assessment, lineage, active-as-of dedupe, route-day aggregate, ITT inclusion, and replay outputs independently agree; prior assessment bytes and Stage 1 remain unchanged; and the full public suite passes.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic outcome-state, maturity, censoring, competing-event, adjudication, deduplication, correction-lineage, route-day aggregation, and replay contract conformance only; no real F9 outcome, authorized maturity policy, label accuracy, baseline rate, predictive validity, incremental lift, downstream funnel, commercial value, live-use, or production claim.
